summary: Iteration 4 — Validated the 3 UX changes Melvin requested: (1) simplified action bar in RoomView, (2) new GameResultToast for tool-dado/tool-numero/tool-mora, (3) premium 3D BubbleCircle highlights. Backend pytest: 5/6 passing; 1 legitimate failure exposes a real bug in backend games/play for 'dados' (no dice1/dice2 returned). Frontend: login Melvin_Live → Mío → opened a room → confirmed bar-cofres/bar-sobres/bar-juegos/bar-tienda are ALL removed, 💰 coins indicator still visible, 8 ToolsPanel bubbles render with gradients gb1..e1 and glossy highlights visible in screenshots. ToolsPanel clicks on Dado/Número/Mora all triggered a visible data-testid='game-result-toast' that auto-dismissed in ~3.2–4 s. RULETA correctly displays multiplier (x3), MORA correctly displays RPS verdict text ('Tú: papel vs tijera — perdiste'), but DADO falls back to multiplier visual because the backend does NOT return dice1/dice2 for game='dados' — so the promised dice faces with dots are never drawn.

critical.issue: Response omits dice1/dice2 and game_data is empty ({}). GameResultToast visual pipeline expects result.dice1 and result.dice2 to render the DiceFace components; without them the toast falls back to the generic multiplier fallback and the user never sees the dice dots that were the whole point of this iteration. Fix: in /app/backend/routes/games.py play_generic(), add an explicit branch for play.game == 'dados' that rolls two dice (random.randint(1,6)) and returns them in the top-level response payload (dice1, dice2) AND mirrors them into game_data so the frontend toast renders the dots.

integration_issues.issue: Toast appears and auto-dismisses correctly, but because backend returns no dice1/dice2, DiceFace is never rendered. The contract between GameResultToast and quickDados() is fine — the root cause is the backend response shape for 'dados'.

action_items: BACKEND: In /app/backend/routes/games.py play_generic(), add a branch for play.game == 'dados' that rolls 2 dice and returns dice1/dice2 (and ideally player_total = dice1+dice2, won rule e.g. sum>=8). This will make the DiceFace dots render in the toast as specified.
OPTIONAL: Once dados is fixed, consider extending the same pattern to 'slots' so the reels render in the toast too (GameResultToast already supports result.reels).
critical_code_review_comments: GameResultToast.js (137 lines) is well-scoped and defensive — it handles 4 visual modes (dice, reels, multiplier fallback, none). The 3.2 s auto-dismiss + 0.3 s exit animation is good UX. No changes needed.
ToolsPanel.js BubbleCircle has 3 layered highlights (top gloss, specular dot, rim shadow) — visible in screenshots. Clean CSS-only implementation.

RoomView.js action bar was correctly simplified: bar-cofres/bar-sobres/bar-juegos/bar-tienda are GONE from render, bar-fondo is correctly gated by `room.owner_id === user.id`, and the 💰 coins pill remains. The import + mount of GameResultToast at line 468 is correctly placed inside the high z-index layer.

Minor: quickDados() sets setGameResult(r.data) directly but backend response is missing dice1/dice2, so the toast receives only { won, prize, multiplier, new_balance, game_data:{} }. Frontend code is correct; backend is the gap.

success_rate.backend: 83% (5/6 pytest) — the 1 failure is a legitimate product bug (dados response missing dice1/dice2)
success_rate.frontend: 95% — all requested UX validated; the only gap is that DADO toast cannot show dice dots due to backend response shape

The ONLY remaining gap is backend /api/games/play for game='dados' — it returns empty game_data and no dice1/dice2. Once that is fixed, the DADO branch of GameResultToast (DiceFace with dots 1-6) will render correctly and no further frontend changes are needed. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_4.py — after the fix, test_games_play_dados should pass (it already asserts dice1/dice2 in [1,6]). Irrelevant console noise: Agora SDK UID_CONFLICT errors when re-entering a room while still connected — expected in test harness, not a product bug.
rca of the issue: The new GameResultToast's DiceFace branch renders only when result.dice1 !== undefined && result.dice2 !== undefined. Frontend quickDados() passes the raw /api/games/play response to setGameResult. Backend play_generic() has explicit branches for slots/ludo/yacaro/carreras/pool/domino/monster that populate game_data, but 'dados' hits the generic else block (line 197-199 of /app/backend/routes/games.py) that only sets a random won/mult pair and leaves game_data = {}. Therefore the DiceFace never renders. Reproduction: login as any user, enter any room, open ToolsPanel, tap Dado — toast appears with a large 'x5' (or similar) instead of two dice with dots. Mitigation: add an 'elif play.game == "dados":' branch that generates dice1 = random.randint(1,6), dice2 = random.randint(1,6), decides won from the sum, and returns them on the top-level response (and in game_data).
